title: Unnav Sarbat
description: Unnav Sarbat (Sharbat-e-Unnab) is a classic Unani medicinal syrup made from Jujube fruit (Ziziphus jujuba), known for its blood-purifying and cooling properties. This classical formulation relieves dry cough. Clears throat irritation. Purifies blood to reduce skin rashes. Helps lower mild fevers.
dosage: 20–30 ml mixed in a glass of warm or plain water daily
